name: Improvisational Focus (Combat, Mythic)
body:
An improvised weapon is a lethal instrument in your hands.

Prerequisite(s): Catch Off-Guard or Throw Anything, Improvisational Focus, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Your bonus on attack rolls with improvised weapons from Improvisational Focus and feats that use Improvisational Focus as a prerequisite (such as Greater Weapon Focus) doubles. With improvised weapons, ½ your character levels count as fighter levels for the purpose of selecting feats that improve your ability with a weapon (such as Weapon Specialization).
